commands.out:
§8[§f🌀§8]§7 Fabrolia commands

Check performance
  /fabrolia regions here — TPS of the spot you stand on
  /fabrolia regions tps — live Main + island TPS above the hotbar (on/off)
  /fabrolia regions — server overview: Main TPS, islands, dimensions
  /fabrolia regions top — the slowest islands with their figures
  /fabrolia regions list — every island, one line each
  /fabrolia stats — mod status and features
  /fabrolia stats entity — entity counts per dimension and type
  /fabrolia regions player  — TPS where another player is

Administration
  /fabrolia regions top verbose — raw island rows for diagnosis
  /fabrolia regions islandentities — entity order on islands (vanilla/parallel)
  /fabrolia regions playerticks — players tick on their island (on/off)
  /fabrolia regions rate here  — slow down or speed up the island you stand on
  /fabrolia functions plan — how datapack functions are split
  /fabrolia config reload — reload config/fabrolia.toml

Terms
  Island: nearby loaded chunks that tick together on their own thread
  TPS: ticks per second; 20 is full speed
  MSPT / ms: time one tick takes; under 50 ms keeps up with 20 TPS
  Click a command to put it into the chat.
